name: Gordon Chester
title: Candidate for San José City Council, District 9 (2026); San José Public Works employee
background: Chester is a lifelong District 9 resident who lives in Cambrian with his wife and daughter in the house he grew up in. He has worked for the City of San José for more than a decade in the Department of Public Works, on the team that regulates telecom companies operating in the city. This is his first run for office. (San José Spotlight, December 2025)

He placed second in the June 2, 2026 primary with 22.2% and is running on housing affordability through more building, permanent supportive housing for homelessness, and safer, more walkable streets. He is endorsed by state Sen. Dave Cortese, Councilmember David Cohen, the Santa Clara County Democratic Party, the South Bay Progressive Alliance, and YIMBY Action, and had raised $54,775 including a $4,000 personal loan. (San José Spotlight; YIMBY Action)
